info.title: API.SH: Dubizzle
info.description: The Dubizzle API from API.SH: public Dubizzle data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Category tree with live listing counts: without `parent` the top-level verticals; with a parent path its sub-categories (property types, car makes and models, classifieds sections), each with the path the search takes as `category` and its number of listings.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dubizzle-categories

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Count only this city's listings (same values as the search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One dubizzle listing by its link or id: title, price, link, location path with coordinates, every photo, description, posting date, verification and contact options shown (phone, WhatsApp); property listings add bedrooms, bathrooms, size, furnishing, completion status, reference and permit numbers, rent frequency, agency fee, building, amenities, property details, agency and agent; motors listings add year, kilometres, make, model, trim, seller type, dealer and every listed spec. The original record is in `raw`. Removed listings answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dubizzle-listing

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Instead of `url`: the listing id (`id` from the search).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: With `id`: the listing's category path, to look in that category only (faster).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
UAE areas, communities, developments, landmarks and buildings matching a name, with the id the search takes as `location_id`, type, city, full path, coordinates and live listing counts per category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dubizzle-locations

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Only this city (same values as the search).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Listings in any dubizzle UAE category (property for rent or sale, motors, classifieds, jobs, community) with the site's filters and sorts: city, location, keywords, price, posted date; for property bedrooms, bathrooms, size, furnishing, amenities, listed by, rent frequency, completion status, agency, verified, video or 360 tour; for motors year, kilometres, seller type, body type, fuel, specs, transmission, colours, doors, cylinders, horsepower, seats, engine size, warranty, drive type, badges, dealer, inspected, export. Each listing has its title, link, price, location with coordinates, photos, description, posting date, the vertical's attributes (bedrooms, size, amenities, agency and agent; or year, kilometres, make, model, trim and every listed spec) and the original record in `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Very deep pages end where the site's own search ends.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/dubizzle-search

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category path as in the site's links, e.g. `property-for-rent/residential/apartmentflat`, `property-for-sale/residential/villahouse`, `property-for-rent/commercial`, `motors/used-cars/toyota/land-cruiser`, `classified/electronics`, `jobs`, `community`. Sub-categories come from /dubizzle/v1/categories. Default `property-for-rent/residential`.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of `category`: a dubizzle search link (its category, city and keyword are used).

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Location ids from /dubizzle/v1/locations (area, community or building), comma-separated.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Property: all of these amenities, comma-separated, e.g. `balcony,shared-pool,covered-parking` (also maids-room, study, central-ac, concierge, private-garden, private-pool, private-gym, shared-gym, security, built-in-wardrobes, walk-in-closet, kitchen-appliances, view-of-water, view-of-landmark, pets-allowed and more).

parameters.name: agency_id
parameters.description: Property: only this agency's listings (`agency.id` of a listing).

parameters.name: verified
parameters.description: Property: only listings the site has verified.

parameters.name: has_tour
parameters.description: Property: only listings with a 360 tour.

parameters.name: body_type
parameters.description: Motors: suv, coupe, sedan, crossover, hard-top-convertible, pick-up-truck, hatchback, soft-top-convertible, sports-car, van, wagon, utility-truck, other (comma-separated).

parameters.name: fuel_type
parameters.description: Motors: petrol, diesel, hybrid, plug-in-hybrid, electric.

parameters.name: regional_specs
parameters.description: Motors: gcc, american, canadian, european, japanese, korean, chinese, other.

parameters.name: exterior_color
parameters.description: Motors: white, silver, grey, black, blue, red, orange, green, yellow, brown, beige, tan, gold, teal, maroon, burgundy, pink, purple, bronze, other.

parameters.name: interior_color
parameters.description: Motors: black, grey, beige, brown, red, white, tan, blue, orange, green, yellow, maroon, pink, other.

parameters.name: target_market
parameters.description: Motors: uae (can be exported) or export (export only).

parameters.name: badges
parameters.description: Motors: all of first-owner, in-warranty, dealer-warranty, service-history, no-accidents, original-paint, service-contract, car-finance.

parameters.name: dealer_id
parameters.description: Motors: only this dealer's listings (`dealer.id` of a listing).

parameters.name: has_360
parameters.description: Motors: only listings with a 360 view.

parameters.name: inspected
parameters.description: Motors: only cars inspected by the site.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order. Property: popular (default), verified, newest, oldest, price_low, price_high. Motors: popular, newest, oldest, price_low, price_high, year_new, year_old, km_low, km_high. Classifieds: popular, newest, oldest, price_low, price_high. Jobs and community: popular, newest.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
